prompts.prompt: Production transparent TREE SPRITE SHEET for existing top-down WWII hex tactics game. Match the supplied existing 256px summer tree crown reference in art style, crown scale, fine painted detail, muted natural color, top-down branching and canopy shading. Reference2 is approved seasonal design. Output a square sheet of EXACTLY FOUR isolated tree crowns arranged in a regular TWO BY TWO grid. One entire tree centered inside each equal square quadrant, at same scale, with approximately 8% clear transparent margin around each crown. The crowns MUST NOT touch each other or cell edges. Genuine transparent alpha background, including gaps between branches. No ground, no lawn, no rectangular dark backdrop, no text, labels, border, perspective, trunk side view, tree shadows extending outside crown, decorations or snow unless requested. Strict orthographic vertical overhead camera: only horizontally radiating crown branches seen from straight above, as in reference, never a conventional side-on upright tree. Each tree fills roughly 84% of its quadrant. Shared light from upper left, subtle dark occlusion inside crown. All four crowns approximately circular with natural asymmetrical edges and distinct branching structures. SPRING four deciduous tree crown variants, young fresh muted sage and olive-green leaf clusters over visible gray-brown radial limbs. New foliage about 65-75% full crown coverage, with organic irregular gaps showing transparent background and branches. Subdued realistic leaf color with upper-left lighter new leaves, no bloom, no fruit, no fluorescent green. Tree forms must read clearly at 40px.
